tasks.label: Build stock ROM
tasks.detail: Reassembles the untouched reconstruction. Must stay byte-identical to the EPROM dump.

tasks.label: Verify stock ROM is byte-identical
tasks.detail: Regression test for any edit to src/stock: the image must still md5 to c021af146a50b93a22d13535201b7eaa.
tasks.command: test "$(md5 -q cc784nir.bin)" = c021af146a50b93a22d13535201b7eaa && echo 'OK: byte-identical to the dump' || { echo 'FAIL: stock ROM no longer matches the dump'; exit 1; }

tasks.label: Diff stock vs patched source
tasks.detail: The diff is the changelog: everything outside the patches is kept identical on purpose.

tasks.label: M27C256 -- verify erased
tasks.detail: Blank check. Must pass before programming; if it fails, back under the UV lamp for another 15 min.

tasks.label: M27C256 -- program
tasks.detail: Writes the patched 32 K image and verifies. Requires a UV-erased chip.

tasks.label: AT28C256-15PU -- program
tasks.detail: Same image as the M27C256; the two socket bodges make the part electrically a 27C256. -u clears software data protection first. NOTE: pin 27 (/WE) to VCC and pin 1 (A14) to Z80 pin 4 before this chip goes in the sign.
